reviews.comment: Lectures are clear but fast-paced, and notes from lecture are not posted.  Homeworks can be very time-consuming.  I definitely recommend studying for exams beyond the homework, since no practice exams are provided.  I kind of slacked in this class, though - take good notes and understand the homeworks and an A is totally doable.

Amazing professor!! His lectures are so thought out and well paced. He answers every question diligently and you can tell he wants everyone to succeed. The exams are common exams and are a little difficult, but just redo each homework again before each one. Going to the hands on grades up was extremely helpful. My favorite prof definitely recommend

This was Dr. Mashburn's first time teaching MATH 151 and he was an excellent lecturer. I appreciated his humor and teaching style, which simplified concepts and made them approachable. He was extremely accessible and had insightful office hours. 10/10 professor, please take in whatever course he is teaching.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was very great at lectures and responding to questions. I didn't have a hard time in this class as long as you take old exams to study because the homework misses a few things. Attendance was only required at recitation, but I still went to all the lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Mashburn is so far the best professor I have had in my time at TAMU. His office hours are very helpful, and his lectures are clear and informative, with questions encouraged. He genuinely cares about student understanding of concepts being taught. Would highly recommend.

Reviews have to be fake.Homeworks would take very long to finish as well as he would put nonsense like fourier series on it. Exams felt very cramp with the 50 min time frame in which his true or false problems were always niche .Reviews available were only multiple problems he chooses from a book or past exams that somewhat help.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's a good professor, engaging and it's obvious he cares about his students and what he teaches. Doesn't post filled out notes so if you miss class you're lost. Short easy quizzes every week based on homework and tests weren't too hard if you studied.

One of the BEST professors I have taken. He makes MATH 152 easy. His lectures are very clear, engaging, and he is always willing to answer questions. Office hours are especially helpful and he will explain concepts to you in detail. Very nice guy in general. The math department makes exams, so they are standardized but usually very difficult.

Reasonable homework, quizzes, and tests. The only thing was that there were no practice exams for tests but instead we were given a number of questions to solve from the textbook. This made prepping for tests a little difficult but I assume this is just MATH 304 in general.

Very nice and caring. Will always take the time to explain things if you raise your hand in class. Homework is due once a week and an in-class quiz based on 1-2 easy homework problems happened once per week. Appears to encourage office hours.

This class was a very difficult A because of how harsh the grading was on exams. However, Dr. Mashburn was very accessible and helpful outside of class. There are iclicker questions for a grade, not for extra credit, so you really need to go to class.

Dr. Mashburn is a wonderful prof and is caring. His lectures are engaging, and he is great at explaining concepts. MATH 140 does have a load of homework. I would go to the math learning center to do all my homework, which helped a lot.

Dr. Mashburn is a genuine guy who explains math steps very clearly. Never had a problem following his lectures. My only complaint is that he is a little picky about showing steps on exams so just write everything down. It's a pretty easy class in general, but Mashburn definitely made it even easier. Drops a lot of grades at end of year too!

(MATH 304). Dr Mashburn does an amazing job at not rushing his lectures and tying the material together in a way that makes it easily understood. He clearly loved what he teaches, and wants to see you succeed. Very clear expectations and schedule as far as homework/quizzes go as well.
Tests are hard in the work out portion

Despite this class being somewhat rigorous, Professor Mashburn supplied us with everything we needed to learn and succeed in the class. From course organization to the examples he used, he made this course very exciting.

Professor Mashburn is sweet and passionate. His notes are very helpful for the homework assigned each week (twice a week, seems like a lot but they are easily doable within 1-2 hours). His textbooks are free and accessible to all and he provides comprehensive test reviews for both midterms and the final. Highly recommend :)
the class wasnt that bad but just do not take it online. it is so much harder without the lectures

His class wasn't too difficult, and he's a pretty nice professor. I wouldn't recommend skipping class because there could be an iclicker or quiz. During group quizzes, sit next to people who know what they are doing
Sooooo much homework. I had to drop this course because of how test heavy it was. He grades pretty harsh, I would not suggest taking this unless you have a LOT of time on your hands.
He is very thorough during the lessons and is very kind. Office hours are very helpful. There's lots of homework but there's many attempts and if you stay on top of it you'll be fine.
He is a very good teacher. His lectures are very clear and straightforward. He is very passionate about the topic.

- Very Test Heavy in general as a class, but Mashburn is very helpful
- Good lecturer - sometimes hard to understand, but mostly great
- Very available to help you learn the content!

I highly recommend Prof. Mashburn, even though I wish I did better in the class!
Mashburn is awesome & explains topics so well! He's a great professor and class was super easy as long as you stay on top of the homework.

I LOVED prof Mashburn!!! He is such an awesome professor, he cares for his students and his lectures are really easy to understand and follow along. I had a friend who missed one of the lectures so she went to his office hours and he retaught her the entire lesson. he reminds me of a highschool teacher, which I enjoyed. IF YOU CAN, TAKE HIM!!!

Jacob is a very kind professor who wants the best for his students. He explains the material in depth during lecture so everyone good understanding of it. The tests are harder than the homework and practice exams given. Would take him again.
This professor is awesome! Super accommodating if needed. Explains things well and doesn't give a ton of homework.
I love jacob mashburn

Really great professor, took over summer '21. Material was very fast paced since it was a summer class, but through doing the homework and paying attention in lecture, it was very doable. Definitely recommend Mashburn for MATH142 and other math courses!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Jacob was one of my fav teachers this semester. Easily reachable and always resounded to emails, and his office hours were always super helpful! He was very easy to follow along with in lecture and posted recordings on google drive. He grades VERY fairly. Quizzes and HW weekly but it is VERY DOABLE. First math class I've made an A in!

Mr. Mashburn was a great professor. The material could be a bit challenging at times but after a little practice it became more understandable. He is very nice and makes math somewhat fun. If youre not into the usual math courses(algebra, calc, geometry, etc.) I highly recommend you take this class.

Mr. Mashburn is a really great professor, he tries his hardest to make this material interesting for all his students. The material isn't super difficult, but can be tedious at times and does require studying. He gives great feedback on quizzes and tests. Overall, great class if you aren't a "math" person and want a professor who loves his job!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: What I loved about this class was the subject matter itself. "Eww math" ya I know but it did not feel like math! Super interesting real world material was used and it was very interesting to learn this stuff. Jacob is very accessible outside of class. Quizzes roughly once a week but he warns you 2 lectures ahead of time for you to prepare

I LOVED him! I would 100% take another math class by him if he teaches one I need. Super funny with his side comments so he kept me entertained throughout the lectures. Sometimes the explanations are confusing but once you start working the examples it all makes sense. Super easy math credit. Would GLADLY take again if I could
